study: R10-E1a train x evaluation contract matrix and R10-E2 declared/actual assembly audit

exposure_status.development: head selection set (early stopping, weight decay) of every learned arm; reported as in-selection, optimistic
exposure_status.test: v1 test 38 drugs, already exposed (v1 D11[cross], non-learned baselines and mixture_t[cross] were scored on it); E1a test numbers are a frozen follow-up comparison on previously exposed data, NOT a blind or independent test

hypothesis: The same-contract deterioration of cross-trained heads relates to the train/evaluation replicate-contract mismatch; same-trained heads must be judged against same-fitted simple baselines (t*_same, W_same). The design does not identify a causal environment share.
input_contract: unchanged from v1: line, episode/dose, endpoint replicate low/high wells, endpoint-replicate vehicle; query RNA/composition/cell number never enter features (configs/r10/r10_v1.json, reports/r10_dose_composition/DATA_CONTRACT.md)

fixed_from_v1.cache: assets/cache/r10_v1 (read-only symlink to the v1 worktree)
fixed_from_v1.atlas: train-only HVG2000/PCA20/GMM K=4 per line (atlas_K.json of r10_b1_v3)
fixed_from_v1.scoring: core.score on the fixed atlas re-read of the assembled cloud
fixed_from_v1.heads: MLP hidden 64x2, dropout 0.1, Adam 1e-3, weight decay grid {1e-4, 1e-2}; pi/Q max 600 epochs patience 60 (KL / weighted residual MSE); W max 150 epochs patience 30, energy distance, batch 64, 128 cells per endpoint in training
fixed_from_v1.selection: per head and seed: weight decay and epoch by the drug-balanced development objective of the SAME replicate contract the head is trained on (pi: declared TV; Q: weighted residual MSE; W: energy distance)

cross.t_star: v1 r10_c3_tstar_v1.json (train cross, t*=0.325 both episodes)

same.W: NEW r10_contract_matrix_v2/train_same_W seeds 0,1,2, same code path with --direction same
same.t_star: NEW r10_contract_matrix_v2/tstar_same.json (train drugs, same triplets, same grid 0..1 step 0.025)

cells: train contract tc in {same, cross} x evaluation contract (triplet direction) in {same, cross}; roles test (primary) and development (secondary); episodes E1000 (primary) and E100 (pre-specified secondary)
d00_rule: D00 does not depend on the training contract; it is evaluated once per triplet and never counted twice
aggregation: seeds -> triplet -> replicate direction -> line (equal weight) -> drug; drug-level bootstrap B=2000 seed 20261117
pairing: within one (role, episode, evaluation contract) cell, on the triplet intersection where both arms have a finite metric; training-contract effects therefore compare cross- and same-trained arms on the same query wells
eval_contract_sensitivity: comparisons across evaluation contracts use the common eligible (line, drug, episode) set with both contracts present; they are drug-paired, not query-well paired

family.question: same-contract training helps on same evaluation
cross-contract training helps on cross evaluation
pi-head beyond the matched global mixing weight (same)
pi-head beyond the matched global mixing weight (cross)
decomposed assembly beyond the global affine model (same)
decomposed assembly beyond the global affine model (cross)

primary.sign: a - b; negative = a has lower (better) actual composition TV
primary.multiplicity: Holm over the six primary contrasts using two-sided percentile-bootstrap p-values p = min(1, 2 min(P*(d<=0), P*(d>=0))); Bonferroni simultaneous intervals (1 - 0.05/6) reported alongside the 95% intervals

practical_threshold.note: plan proposal value (not a v1 rule), fixed here before scoring

equivalence.rule: equivalence only if the 90% bootstrap interval lies inside (-margin, +margin); a 95% interval containing 0 alone is 'difference not established'

secondary.status: all reported, no multiplicity correction, labelled secondary; never promoted to primary after seeing results
contrasts_per_cell: X[tc] - D00 for X in D10, D01, D11, W, tstar
D10[tc] - tstar[tc] and D10[tc] - tstar[other tc] (baseline contract sensitivity)
D11[tc] - D10[tc] (within-state mean RMSE / within ED / ED: does Q add to pi)
D11[tc] - W[tc] (TV and ED claimed separately)
X[same] - X[cross] for X in D10, D01, D11, W, tstar (training-contract effect, same query wells)
secondary.contract_interaction: (X[same]@same - X[cross]@same) - (X[same]@cross - X[cross]@cross) on the common eligible set; named contract_interaction, distinct from arm_interaction
secondary.strata: line; replicate direction (rep_endpoint->rep_query); query plate relation (query on low-endpoint plate / high-endpoint plate / neither); descriptive, with drug bootstrap intervals

values.tv_actual_query: comp_tv = TV(pi_actual reread, pi_query) -- always the primary metric

e2_audit.strata: tertiles of each endpoint diagnostic within role x episode (cut points computed on all triplets of that role x episode, before looking at mismatch)
e2_audit.no_reselection: drugs with large mismatch are never used to redefine the primary analysis

conditional_unlocks.evaluated_on: development role only (source/selection data), E1000, matched cells (same->same, cross->cross); test numbers never unlock anything
conditional_unlocks.U1_mismatch_limits_performance: for D10[tc] in its matched cell, mean drug-level (comp_tv - head_comp_tv) >= 0.005 with 95% lower bound > 0, in BOTH training contracts
conditional_unlocks.U2_ranking_changes: for any tc and any pair in {(D10,D00), (D11,D00), (D10,tstar[tc]), (D11,tstar[tc])}: the declared-TV estimate and the actual-TV estimate have opposite signs and at least one of their 95% intervals excludes 0
conditional_unlocks.epoch_ranking: not assessable from v1 artifacts (only the best checkpoint and the declared-TV curve are stored); recorded as such
conditional_unlocks.unlock_7_2_4_hard_partition: only together with 7.2.3 (mismatch-repair control, not a required fix)
conditional_unlocks.unlock_7_1_5_source_oof: only if 7.2.3 is unlocked (new objective/model selection continues and needs source-only selection data)

cost_rule: same-W pilot = seed 0 with both weight decays; remaining seeds only if the measured cost keeps the full package within ~24 h wall under the track caps (12 jobs, CPU)
